name: clawnify
description: Work on your Clawnify organization: ground answers in your company knowledge, check and fix your AI agents, and build and deploy apps and websites on the platform.

interface.longDescription: Clawnify runs AI agents, business apps and a company knowledge base for your organization. Connect your Clawnify account to search and cite your company's policies and documents, see what your AI agents did and adjust their instructions, look up your apps and flows and work with their data, and keep shared memory and tasks. The included skills cover building Clawnify apps and websites and organizing company knowledge. Requires a Clawnify account. It only reaches the organizations the signed-in person belongs to.
defaultPrompt: What does our company knowledge say about our refund policy?
Summarize what our Support agent did in its last conversation.
List the apps we've built on Clawnify.

positive.description: Answer from company knowledge and cite the document
positive.expected_behavior: Answers from the published "Refund policy" document in the demo organization (refunds within 30 days of purchase) and cites it as "Per Refund policy v<N>". Adds no terms the document does not contain.

positive.prompt: Which AI agents do we have on Clawnify, and is each one running?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo organization's agents by name, including the agent named Support, with each one's status.

positive.prompt: Summarize what our Support agent did in its last conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Support agent's most recent session and summarizes that conversation from its transcript, without inventing steps the transcript does not show.

positive.prompt: Remember that our fiscal year starts in April.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves one memory stating that the fiscal year starts in April and confirms it was saved.

positive.description: Find an app and its link
positive.prompt: What apps have we built on Clawnify, and what's the link to the CRM?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo organization's apps by name and gives the URL of the app named CRM.

negative.description: Bulk deletion without naming what to delete
negative.expected_behavior: Deletes nothing without the user's approval. clawnify_delete_app is annotated destructive, so ChatGPT asks for confirmation before each deletion; declining leaves every app in place.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Rome today?
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no Clawnify tool. The request is outside what the plugin does.

negative.description: Data from an organization the account does not belong to
negative.prompt: Show me the company knowledge of another company on Clawnify.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines. The connection reaches only the organizations the signed-in account belongs to (for the demo account, ChatGPT Demo alone), so no other organization's knowledge can be read.

review.commerce_description: Clawnify does not sell products or take payments in ChatGPT or Codex.

publication.release_notes: First release: the Clawnify connector (company knowledge, projects, memory, tasks, agents, apps and flows) and four skills for building on Clawnify and organizing company knowledge.
